features.description: Declarative PrereqProbe registry + profile filtering + JSON output. Build a PrereqProbe dataclass in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/prereq_registry.py with fields {name, probe_command, version_constraint, fix_url, fix_command, auto_install_safe, why_needed, required_for_profiles}. Define ~10 initial probes covering the three first-user blockers (GitHub auth via `gh auth status`, Python >=3.10, codex CLI presence) + existing doctor checks (claude CLI, git user.email, network to api.anthropic.com, jq, firebase CLI when profile requires it, gcloud when profile requires it, SA key when profile requires it). Five profiles: core (default; minimal for any DontPanic user), discord (adds Discord webhook + sanitization regex), firebase-dashboard (adds Firebase auth + gcloud + SA key + target-project), openclaw (adds OpenRouter key + openclaw CLI if applicable), ci (adds GitHub Actions runner constraints). Wire into scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py: new --profile=<name> flag filters which probes emit red/yellow vs irrelevant. --json output extends the existing stable schema with a prereq_probes array including per-probe {name, status, version_found, fix_url, fix_command, profile_membership}. Network probes (anthropic API reachability, openrouter ping) run in a ThreadPoolExecutor with per-probe 2s cap. Full sweep <=10s wall clock. Backwards compat: doctor with no flags keeps existing 0/1/2 exit-code matrix; new probes are additive; default profile=core filters to the same set humans expect to see today + the three first-user blockers. CRITICAL: `--profile=core` must never red-flag Firebase, agent-conventions, or other maintainer-only deps. **Ship-fast and independently shippable; operator pause point before F002-F004.**
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py end-to-end. Map the existing CheckResult/run_all_checks/render_text/render_json pipeline. Document the seam where new prereq probes plug in without disturbing the existing flow.

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/prereq_registry.py with PrereqProbe dataclass (frozen=True) carrying {name: str, probe_command: list[str] | callable, version_constraint: str | None, fix_url: str, fix_command: str, auto_install_safe: bool, why_needed: str, required_for_profiles: frozenset[str], timeout_s: float = 2.0}. Add ProfileRegistry with the five profiles (core, discord, firebase-dashboard, openclaw, ci) — each profile is a frozenset of probe names it requires red-status for. NOT YET in this file: a `maintainer` profile (defer to Roadmap Plan 5/7).

Define ~10 initial probes covering: (a) gh-auth-status (probe `gh auth status`; profiles: ci, openclaw-when-pushing); (b) python-version (probe sys.version_info >= (3,10); profiles: core); (c) codex-cli (probe `which codex`; profiles: core-when-auditor-codex); (d) claude-cli (probe `which claude`; profiles: core); (e) git-user-email (probe `git config user.email`; profiles: core); (f) anthropic-api-network (probe HTTPS HEAD to api.anthropic.com:443 with 2s cap; profiles: core); (g) jq (existing); (h) firebase-cli (profiles: firebase-dashboard); (i) gcloud (profiles: firebase-dashboard); (j) sa-key (profiles: firebase-dashboard); (k) discord-webhook + sanitization-regex (profiles: discord); (l) openrouter-key + openclaw-cli (profiles: openclaw).

Each probe MUST carry a `fix_url` (vendor docs link) AND a `fix_command` (copy-pasteable shell snippet). When a probe has no automatic fix (e.g. `gh auth login` is interactive), `fix_command` describes the interactive flow. Probes with `auto_install_safe=True` are limited to homebrew/pip operations explicitly opt-in per probe — never sudo, never system-Python modifications, never pipx --force, never global brew installs without operator selecting the auto-fix interactively (F002 enforces this).

Wire ProbeRunner that executes probes in a ThreadPoolExecutor with per-probe timeout (default 2s). Returns ProbeResult per probe. Aggregate results filtered by --profile. Full sweep wall clock <=10s for all five profiles combined (parallel network probes + serial local probes).

Extend scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py: add `--profile=<name>` argparse flag (default `core`). Wire ProbeRunner output into the existing CheckResult pipeline as a new probe set. JSON output (--json) extends existing schema additively: top-level adds a `prereq_probes` array with per-probe {name, status: pass|warn|fail|irrelevant, version_found, fix_url, fix_command, profile_membership, elapsed_s}. Text output adds a `Prereq probes for profile=X:` section with red/green chips + copy-paste fix commands inline.

Backwards-compat: doctor with no flags (no --profile, no --json) keeps its existing render_text + 0/1/2 exit-code matrix and existing check set. The new prereq probes are additive when --profile is supplied; otherwise omitted from the legacy output path. Existing test suite must continue to pass.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_prereq_registry_f001.py covering: (a) PrereqProbe dataclass field validation, (b) ProfileRegistry filtering — `--profile=core` excludes firebase/openrouter probes, `--profile=firebase-dashboard` includes them, (c) ProbeRunner per-probe timeout enforcement (synthetic slow probe times out at 2s, not 10s), (d) parallel network probe execution stays under 10s budget for the full sweep, (e) JSON output schema is stable (snapshot test with field order pinned), (f) `--profile=core` does NOT emit Firebase/agent-conventions red flags, (g) the three first-user blockers (gh auth, python>=3.10, codex CLI) appear in core profile with accurate fix_url + fix_command, (h) `--profile=unknown` returns argparse error with the valid profile list.

Add a small extension test in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_profile_integration.py: synthetic stub of subprocess.run for each probe command + assert doctor's CLI output (text + JSON) includes the prereq section under each profile. Confirm exit code matrix unchanged for the no-flag path.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Confirm baseline (>=2036 green post-Plan 4 F003+F005) is preserved.

(2) ~10 initial probes registered covering the three first-user blockers + existing doctor probes. Each probe has `fix_url` AND `fix_command`. (3) scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py exposes `--profile=<name>` flag (default `core`); --json output extends the existing stable schema with a `prereq_probes` array; --no-flag path keeps the existing 0/1/2 exit-code matrix and probe set unchanged. (4) Network probes run in a ThreadPoolExecutor with per-probe 2s timeout; full sweep <=10s wall clock. (5) `--profile=core` does NOT red-flag Firebase, agent-conventions, or other maintainer-only deps. (6) New test module test_prereq_registry_f001.py with >=8 cases + new test_doctor_profile_integration.py covering each profile end-to-end. (7) Full sweep >=2036 green; sanitization clean.

features.description: `dontpanic init` interactive installer. New CLI subcommand at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py. Runs doctor for the selected profile (via F001's ProbeRunner), renders the prereq checklist, executes safe auto-fixes (probes with `auto_install_safe=True` like `brew install codex`, `pip install -e .`), prompts copy-paste commands for unsafe ones (token creation, SA key generation). `--non-interactive` flag for agent installers: errors with structured exit code + JSON output instead of prompting, lists what would have been prompted. `--profile=<name>` flag honored (default `core`). Idempotent re-runs — running `dontpanic init` after a partial fix re-runs the doctor probes and shows the remaining red items without redoing the already-green ones. **Does NOT install Windows-only deps; does NOT auto-create GitHub PATs; does NOT auto-generate Firebase SA keys.** Safe auto-fix execution is gated on operator confirmation per-probe by default; `--auto-fix-safe` flag executes all `auto_install_safe=True` probes without prompting.
steps: Read F001's prereq_registry.py + the existing scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py subcommand wiring pattern (architecture, dispatch-from-plan, doctor subcommands). Document the seam where the new `init` subcommand plugs in.
Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py as a new subpackage. Module entry: init_main(argv: list[str]) -> int returning exit code (0=ready, 1=remaining-fixes, 2=blocked).

Implement Walker class that runs ProbeRunner for the selected profile, groups results by status (green/yellow/red), and yields a per-probe interactive prompt for red items. For each red probe: print why_needed + fix_command. If auto_install_safe=True, prompt 'Run `<fix_command>`? [Y/n]'. If False, print the command and 'Press Enter when done, or Ctrl-C to abort'. Re-run the probe after operator action; continue to next.

Implement --non-interactive mode: if any probe is red, exit with code 1 and JSON output listing all red probes + their fix_command. No prompts, no auto-execution. This is the agent-installer code path.

Implement --auto-fix-safe mode (alternative to interactive): for each red probe with auto_install_safe=True, execute fix_command via subprocess.run() with stdout/stderr captured, then re-run probe. For probes with auto_install_safe=False, fall through to the non-interactive path (exit 1 with structured output).
Idempotency: each invocation runs the full ProbeRunner sweep fresh. No persistent state file. Re-running `dontpanic init` after a partial fix automatically picks up the new probe results.

Wire CLI subcommand `dontpanic init` in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py with flags: --profile=<name> (default core), --non-interactive, --auto-fix-safe (mutually exclusive with --non-interactive), --json (machine-readable output even in interactive mode). Help text references the doctor's profile list.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_init_walker_f002.py covering: (a) all-green path exits 0 with no prompts, (b) red probe with auto_install_safe=True triggers prompt in interactive mode + executes in --auto-fix-safe mode (use subprocess.run mock), (c) red probe with auto_install_safe=False prompts copy-paste in interactive mode + reports structurally in --non-interactive mode, (d) --non-interactive exits 1 with JSON listing all red probes when any are red, (e) idempotent re-run picks up new probe results without state file, (f) --auto-fix-safe stops at the first unsafe probe and falls through to non-interactive output, (g) operator-aborted prompt (Ctrl-C simulated via subprocess interrupt) exits with code 130.

Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_init_cli_integration.py: spawn `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate init --profile=core --non-interactive --json` as subprocess against a synthetic fixture; assert JSON output structure + exit code.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py exposes init_main(argv) entry point. (2) `dontpanic init --profile=<name>` runs doctor for the selected profile and walks an interactive checklist for red items (default interactive mode). (3) `--non-interactive` flag exits 1 with structured JSON listing red probes; never prompts. (4) `--auto-fix-safe` flag executes only `auto_install_safe=True` fix_commands without prompting; falls through to non-interactive output for unsafe ones. (5) Idempotent re-runs work without a state file. (6) NEVER auto-creates GitHub PATs, NEVER auto-generates Firebase SA keys, NEVER runs sudo or system-Python modifications. (7) New test modules test_init_walker_f002.py (>=7 cases) + test_init_cli_integration.py covering the CLI surface. (8) Full sweep >=2036 green; sanitization clean.

features.description: Smoke test harness at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py. Synthetic plan fixture (a 1-feature throwaway plan in a tmpdir) + mocked claude/codex executors that exercise `supervisor.dispatch_volley` end-to-end without paid API calls. Confirms install actually works before the user wastes tokens. Catches the three first-user blockers (missing claude CLI, missing codex CLI, broken Python env) by failing fast with a clear error. Wired into `dontpanic init` as the final step + available standalone as `dontpanic smoke`. Bounded <=30s wall clock. The mock executors return fixed signed_off envelopes that exercise every supervisor branch the real dispatch path would hit (admission gate, quota, execution-env setup, audit JSON write, transcript write, signoff envelope, INBOX event), with no network calls and no real LLM invocations.
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/supervisor.py end-to-end to understand the dispatch_volley contract (inputs, outputs, side effects, mock seams). Document the points where a mock executor needs to inject envelopes vs. where the runtime can be exercised as-is.
Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py as a new subpackage. Module entry: smoke_main(argv: list[str]) -> int.

Implement SyntheticPlanFixture: creates a tmpdir with a minimal docs/plans/<synthetic-id>/{plan.md, features.json, decisions.jsonl} layout that validates against the v1.9 schema. plan.md has 1 trivial feature, child_charter pointing to /dev/null parent. The synthetic plan ID uses a `smoke-` prefix to be obviously not-a-real-plan (e.g., `2026-05-19-901-smoke-feat-synthetic`).

Implement MockClaudeExecutor + MockCodexExecutor subclasses of BaseExecutor (or equivalent — read the existing executor.py to find the right seam). They return fixed claude-implementer-Fxxx-i0.json + codex-auditor-Fxxx-i0.json envelopes with `signed_off` verdict and minimal-but-valid content. No subprocess.run calls; no network.

Implement run_smoke() that: (a) sets up SyntheticPlanFixture, (b) invokes supervisor.dispatch_volley with the mocked executors, (c) asserts the supervisor produces audit JSONs + signoff envelope + transcript + INBOX event, (d) asserts every branch of dispatch_volley that a real run would hit is exercised (admission, quota, env-registry, execution-env-root, audit write, signoff write, INBOX append), (e) cleans up the tmpdir on exit (success OR failure). Bounded <=30s wall clock.

Implement smoke output: pretty terminal (green checkmarks per supervisor branch exercised) + --json (structured output with per-branch status + elapsed_s + any errors). Exit code 0 = smoke pass, 1 = supervisor branch failed (real defect), 2 = environmental blocker (no claude CLI, missing dependency, etc — flag as install issue).

Wire CLI subcommand `dontpanic smoke` in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py with flags: --json, --profile=<name> (filters which probes the smoke run requires — defaults to whatever profile is needed for the supervisor's minimum surface, currently `core`).

Wire smoke into `dontpanic init` as the final step (post-fix-loop). If init reaches all-green status, run smoke automatically; if smoke fails with a real defect (exit 1), surface it loud. If smoke fails with env blocker (exit 2), surface as 'install issue remaining' and re-enter the fix loop.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_smoke_harness_f003.py covering: (a) happy-path smoke with mock executors signed_off exits 0 in <30s, (b) mock executor returning needs_changes triggers a real supervisor branch (mini-volley loop) and still exits 0 after the loop cap, (c) supervisor branch failure (e.g., admission rejection) exits 1 with structured error, (d) missing claude CLI on the host short-circuits to exit 2 with the prereq fix_url, (e) cleanup happens on exception (tmpdir removed even when supervisor raises), (f) --json output schema is stable, (g) wall clock <30s.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py exposes smoke_main(argv) entry point with SyntheticPlanFixture + MockClaudeExecutor + MockCodexExecutor + run_smoke() implementation. (2) `dontpanic smoke` runs a synthetic plan through `supervisor.dispatch_volley` with mocked executors in <=30s wall clock, no paid API calls, no network. (3) Exit codes: 0=smoke pass, 1=supervisor branch failed (real defect), 2=environmental blocker (install issue). (4) JSON output (--json) is stable schema. (5) `dontpanic init` automatically runs smoke as its final step after all probes pass; smoke env-blocker exit re-enters the fix loop. (6) New test module test_smoke_harness_f003.py with >=7 cases. (7) Full sweep >=2036 green; sanitization clean.

features.description: HTML install report (Thariq pattern). Single-page artifact at docs/install-report.html. Pure transform from the JSON output of `dontpanic doctor --json` + `dontpanic smoke --json` into a self-contained HTML document. Joyful design (per Thariq — see Plan 4 F002 architecture_html.py for the pattern + style baseline), no JS framework, no external CSS, no external fonts. Mobile-responsive (single column < 800px, two-column wider). Copy-paste-friendly fix commands (each in a styled code block with hover affordance). Per-probe status badges (green/yellow/red). 'What's next' panel calls out the highest-priority red probe with a direct copy-paste fix. Footer links to README + Hermes cheat sheet. Generated by `dontpanic init --report` and `dontpanic doctor --report`. Output is gitignored (operators regen locally; no noisy HTML diffs in PR review).
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_html.py (Plan 4 F002) for the pattern + style baseline. Document the exact CSS variables + render_html signature to keep visual consistency between the architecture map and the install report.

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/report_html.py: pure transform render_install_report(doctor_payload: dict, smoke_payload: dict | None) -> str returning a single HTML5 string. Mirror the architecture_html.py style baseline (CSS variables, mobile-first layout, joyful color palette).

Implement validator _validate_doctor_payload + _validate_smoke_payload that type-check the input dicts against the stable JSON schema (mirror Plan 4 F002 D004 finding pattern — don't trust raw input). Raise InstallReportError with operator-actionable message on shape mismatch.

Implement render sections: (a) Header: 'DontPanic install status — profile=<name>' + generated_at timestamp + overall verdict chip (ready / fixes-needed / blocked), (b) 'What's next' panel: highest-priority red probe (or 'all green' celebration), (c) Per-profile prereq checklist: probes grouped by profile with green/yellow/red badges + fix_command in copy-styled code block, (d) Smoke test results: per-supervisor-branch chips + elapsed_s, (e) Footer: links to README, Hermes cheat sheet, and 'rerun this report' command.
All operator-facing output is html.escape'd at every interpolation seam (mirror Plan 4 F002 D004 defense-in-depth pattern). No raw HTML from probe outputs reaches the rendered document.

Wire `dontpanic doctor --report [--report-path=PATH]` and `dontpanic init --report` CLI flags. Both invoke render_install_report and write to docs/install-report.html (or the override path). Update .gitignore to ignore docs/install-report.html (track only the regen command, not the output).

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_install_report_html_f004.py covering: (a) valid doctor + smoke payload renders complete document with all sections, (b) doctor-only payload (no smoke) still renders cleanly with smoke section omitted, (c) all-green payload renders the 'celebration' variant of 'What's next', (d) red probe payload renders the 'highest-priority' fix prominently, (e) malformed payload raises InstallReportError with operator-actionable message, (f) injection attempt in probe.name / fix_command is escaped (no raw <script> in output), (g) mobile-responsive media query present, (h) generated HTML is well-formed HTML5 (mirror the well-formed assertion from Plan 4 F002 tests).
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Sanity-check the rendered HTML in Chrome on macOS (operator-side smoke test; not test-automated).
